selected_candidate.title: Bound IndexedDB startup and fall back transparently to session memory
selected_candidate.reason: The current browser store can leave 11520 boot waiting forever when IndexedDB open is blocked or never settles. A bounded current-main repair can preserve playability without creating external authority or claiming durable persistence.

requirements: Reject IndexedDB open attempts that remain unsettled beyond a positive bounded timeout.
Reject blocked opens immediately and close a database handle that succeeds after the timeout.
Use durable IndexedDB only after ready() succeeds.
Fall back to a new in-memory store when IndexedDB is unavailable, blocked, failed or timed out.
Expose MEMORY_FALLBACK to the runtime and visibly explain that refresh resets session data.
Keep ordinary durable startup free of fallback warnings.
Do not add wallet, signer, network-write, payment, Mainnet, governance or external-agent capability.
